Recorded claim:
The filter has two linked states: which item summaries are visible and which items select-all/deselect-all acts on. D210599 review found that merely showing every row after clearing the query left _filteredItems stale. The landed empty-query branch clones _items into _filteredItems and unhides every element. It also supports case-insensitive token and quoted-phrase matches over title or description. Current code still resets the data set, though the event source changed later to the search-bar autocomplete event.
